sources.entry: CloudCLI (Claude Code UI) by siteboon - A web and mobile PWA for driving Claude Code (and Cursor/Codex/Gemini) from any device — file explorer, git, integrated shell, and full session management that reads and writes your real ~/.claude config rather than duplicating it. By far the most-adopted Claude Code UI, with a self-hostable open-source core, an optional Docker microVM sandbox mode, a plugin

summary.one_liner: CloudCLI (Claude Code UI) is an open-source web and mobile UI for running Claude Code, Cursor CLI, and Codex sessions from any browser, self-hosted or via a hosted cloud option.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a desktop and mobile UI for Claude Code, Cursor CLI, and Codex that runs locally or remotely so you can view active projects and sessions from other devices. It includes a chat interface for talking to the agents, an integrated shell terminal that gives direct access to the agent CLI, and a file explorer with syntax highlighting and live editing. A Git explorer lets you view, stage, and commit changes and switch branches. Session management covers resuming conversations and tracking history, and existing sessions are discovered automatically from ~/.claude. The README also mentions a plugin system for adding custom tabs and backend services, optional TaskMaster AI integration, and a browser-use feature.
use_cases: Drive Claude Code from a phone or tablet
Resume and manage multiple Claude Code sessions
Browse, edit, and commit project files with an agent nearby
Run agents in an isolated Docker sandbox
Use Claude Code, Cursor CLI, and Codex from one web UI
Host a coding-agent workspace for remote access
notable: Reads and writes the same ~/.claude config Claude Code uses, so MCP servers and settings are shared rather than duplicated
Plugin system with git-installable plugins that add tabs and backend services
Optional Docker sandbox mode running in a microVM (experimental)
Hosted CloudCLI Cloud option built on the same open-source UI layer
Desktop companion app for macOS and Windows
caveats: Requires Node.js v22+ for the npm install
Docker Sandbox mode is marked experimental and needs the sbx CLI
Private-repo plugin installs need git credentials configured for the server's OS user
Hosted CloudCLI Cloud starts at €7/month; you also need your own AI subscription
All Claude Code tools are disabled by default and must be enabled manually
